$description: The Locus brand pack. Written by brand/source/build.mjs; README.md says the same for people. Paths are relative to this file.
name: Locus
meaning: Latin for “place”: the spot on a map where something is.
tagline: A map of your company that any agent can read.
description: A map of your company that any agent can read. Encrypted, gated, open source.

names.product: Locus, with a capital L, in running text as in the lockup.
names.package: locus-harness on npm; the command it installs is locus.
names.never: npx locus: that name on npm belongs to someone else. Write npx -y locus-harness.

rules: Never redraw, trace, recolour, stretch, rotate or add effects to the mark. Take a file from logo/.
Each size is its own drawing: use the file drawn for the size you need (by device pixels), never a large one scaled down.
Black lines on a white tile, on every page. On a light page use the light files (they carry a 1 device px hairline); on a dark page, the dark ones.
The mark is ink and paper only. Vermilion means sealed, amber urgent and blue live, and none of them ever enters the mark.
Clear space is half the mark’s height on every side. The smallest mark is 16 px; the smallest lockup has a 20 px mark.
One face, Spline Sans Mono. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, case and ink, never a second family.
The mark’s only motion is being drawn once (logo/motion/). Nothing loops, glows or bounces.

alert.means: Amber: urgent, it needs you now, and nothing else.

live.means: Blue: live, and nothing else. The live dot, and the sea when a copy is live.

paper.means: The Studio’s ground: the sea round the map.

field.means: A field or a key on a raised sheet.

raised.means: Paper that floats over the map: cards, sheets, menus. The mark’s tile is this paper.

ink.means: Text, lines and the mark. Everything is ink or a share of it.

ink-rgb.means: Ink as r, g, b, for shares of it.

faint.means: Tertiary text: meta, numbers beside labels.

hair-strong.means: A hairline that is on: hover, pressed, chosen.

vermilion.means: Sealed, and nothing else: a sealed area, its wax seal.

live-sea.means: The sea while a copy is live: the one moment blue floods the map.

vermilion-ink.means: Vermilion as text: a sealed area’s words.

wax-shadow.means: The shadow under a wax seal.

grid.means: The faint grid on a map plate.

dash.means: County borders: dashed hairlines between areas.

term.means: A terminal’s ground: commands to copy.

term-edge.means: A terminal’s edge, on dark pages.

reader.means: A reader’s colour on the website’s graphics.

type.family: 'Spline Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

weights.500: labels, a name, a button that matters

scale.13: controls and body in the Studio
scale.24–32: a section’s heading on the website

type.advance: Monospaced: every character is 0.6 em wide.
